messages:
sam_cs: Ironclad Shipping reached out with a new model ask — compact multimodal parser (~7B) for on-prem. Needs OCR from dock photos, manifest field extraction, PII redaction at edge, hazmat detection, HSM/KMS integration, and 90d audit logs. They want eval + rollout proposal before renewal in ~6 weeks. Can ENG + SE triage?

raul_runtime: Looping in runtime. Quick Qs: their target p95 for text/OCR, and on-prem GPU types? q4 quant likely but need infra to size KV cache.

mira_se: I'll send intake checklist and request 250 sample manifests + 120 photos. I'll also draft enablement deck and a runbook.

sam_cs: Must-haves: hazmat recall >= 0.95, no PII telemetry leaving their network (redaction must run at edge), audit retention 90d. Renewal flagged as time-sensitive if we miss the window.

raul_runtime: HSM note: need PKCS#11 endpoint and test creds. Proposed models: rwd-7b-q4 (low-latency) + rwd-7b-q2 (cost fallback). OCR p95 can be higher (~500-700ms).

mira_se: Draft eval plan: 5k labeled examples, metrics = entity precision/recall/F1, hazmat recall, redaction success, p95 latency. Canary: 10% traffic for 7 days; rollback criteria: hazmat recall <0.93 or any PII leakage. I'll own harness + dashboard. Example run: 

python eval_harness.py --model rwd-7b-q4 --data ironclad_samples.jsonl --metrics recall,precision,f1,latency --out ironclad_report.json

ops_bot: Checklist created: [intake_sent] [samples_requested] [hsm_info_requested] [eval_assigned] [canary_planned]. Will ping @sam_cs on updates.

sam_cs: Thanks. I'll loop in AE and mark account health = watch. Please add any risks here so I can escalate quickly. :thumbsup:
